result.brief: 将视频超分重构为运动感知的潜在状态预测，用稀疏注意力潜在世界Transformer实现时序一致的高质量重建。
result.reason: Formulates video super-resolution as motion-aware latent state prediction inspired by world models, with a Latent World Transformer for spatio-temporal modeling; directly touches video world modeling and video generation representation.
